description: This is a Java source file defining the ContractService class, which provides business logic for managing contracts, including printing, approval workflows, and retrieval operations within a Spring application.

classes.name: ContractService
classes.description: Service class for handling business logic related to Contracts, including printing, approval, and retrieval.

methods.name: print
methods.description: Uses PdfService to print the given Contract as a PDF file.

methods.name: sendToSupervisor
methods.description: Sends a contract for approval to the first available supervisor who can accept it, based on value constraints.

methods.name: acceptContract
methods.description: Marks a contract as accepted if the current authenticated user is authorized to accept it.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Retrieves a Contract by its unique identifier.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Persists the provided Contract object to the database.

methods.name: findByClient
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Contracts associated with a specific Client.

methods.name: findByAcceptedBy
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Contracts accepted by a specific User.
